name: Red Crescent

flag.description: A red crescent in the center of a white field, its horns opening towards the fly.
flag.symbolism: Like the Red Cross, the emblem marks medical workers and the wounded as protected in war; it is used by the national societies of most Muslim-majority countries.

hook: The Red Crescent is a lone red crescent on plain white; Turkey turns it around, with a white crescent and star on red.
trivia: The crescent was first used by the Ottoman Empire during the Russo-Turkish War of 1876–1878 and was formally recognized in the 1929 Geneva Convention.
A third, religiously neutral emblem, the Red Crystal, was added in 2005.
